def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().splitlines()
    
    BuildingNum = int(data[0])
    HeightList = list(map(int, data[1].split()))
    
    Height_FirstBuld = HeightList[0]
    found = 0
    
    for i in range(1, len(HeightList)):
        if HeightList[i] > Height_FirstBuld:
            print(i + 1)
            found = 1
            break
    
    if found == 0:
        print(-1)
